metadata.question: Was the nighttime brightness over Mayfield, Kentucky higher in November 2021 than on December 10-12, 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: VIIRS Nighttime Lights (VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG for monthly, VIIRS/DNB/DAILY for daily) - Location: Mayfield, Kentucky (approximately 36.74°N, 88.64°W) - Dates: November 2021 (entire month) vs. December 10-12, 2021 (specific 3-day period) - Note: Mayfield was severely damaged by a tornado on December 10, 2021, which likely caused power outages 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for nighttime lights - Use quality flags if available to filter out poor quality observations 3. Logic: - Compare mean nighttime radiance between two periods - Valid Zero: If radiance is legitimately 0 or very low (e.g., after tornado damage), answer A or B - C1: If no images found for either period - C2: If images exist but no valid pixels after processing - C3: If calculation returns None/NaN ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
mayfield = ee.Geometry.Point([-88.64, 36.74])
buffer_distance = 5000  # 5km buffer around Mayfield center

# 2. Data Acquisition for November 2021
# Using VIIRS monthly product for November
nov_col = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG') \
    .filterDate('2021-11-01', '2021-12-01') \
    .filterBounds(mayfield)

print(f"November 2021 images: {nov_col.size().getInfo()}")

if nov_col.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No data for November 2021.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# 3. Data Acquisition for December 10-12, 2021
# Using daily VIIRS data
dec_col = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/DAILY') \
    .filterDate('2021-12-10', '2021-12-13') \
    .filterBounds(mayfield)

print(f"December 10-12, 2021 images: {dec_col.size().getInfo()}")

if dec_col.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No data for December 10-12, 2021.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# 4. Calculate mean radiance for November
nov_img = nov_col.mean()
nov_radiance = nov_img.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
    geometry=mayfield.buffer(buffer_distance),
    scale=500,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get('avg_rad').getInfo()

nov_count = nov_img.select('avg_rad').reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry=mayfield.buffer(buffer_distance),
    scale=500,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get('avg_rad').getInfo()

print(f"November pixels: {nov_count}, Mean radiance: {nov_radiance}")

# 5. Calculate mean radiance for December 10-12
dec_img = dec_col.mean()
dec_radiance = dec_img.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
    geometry=mayfield.buffer(buffer_distance),
    scale=500,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get('DNB_At_Sensor_Radiance_500m').getInfo()

dec_count = dec_img.select('DNB_At_Sensor_Radiance_500m').reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry=mayfield.buffer(buffer_distance),
    scale=500,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get('DNB_At_Sensor_Radiance_500m').getInfo()

print(f"December 10-12 pixels: {dec_count}, Mean radiance: {dec_radiance}")

# 6. Validation & Final Answer
if nov_count == 0 or dec_count == 0:
    print("No valid pixels after processing.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
elif nov_radiance is None or dec_radiance is None:
    print("Calculation failed - None values.")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
else:
    print(f"November avg: {nov_radiance:.4f}, December 10-12 avg: {dec_radiance:.4f}")
    if nov_radiance > dec_radiance:
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
